channel.title: The HDF Group — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by The HDF Group (hdfg).

item.title: CVE-2026-17574 · 5.2 MEDIUM — NULL Pointer Dereference in HDF5 via Invalid Variable-Length Datatype Type Tag
item.description: HDF5 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability. Processing a crafted HDF5 file containing an attribute with an invalid variable-length datatype type field may cause the application to crash when the attribute is read.

item.title: CVE-2026-17573 · 4 MEDIUM — Double Free in H5D__chunk_copy() in HDF5 via a Crafted Chunk-Index Size Field
item.description: A double free vulnerability was discovered in the HDF5 library. Processing a crafted HDF5 file containing an oversized chunk size field via h5repack may cause the application to abort due to a double free.

item.title: CVE-2026-17572 · 5.5 MEDIUM — HDF5 SOHM List Index Heap Buffer Overflow
item.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SOHM list-index deserialization code in HDF5 through 2.1.1 on all platforms allows attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a crafted HDF5 file whose shared-message list index declares a num_messages count…
